retrieval: BM25 over Japanese character bigrams; query=assignment goal + actual lesson summary + curriculum text; documents=title+body; k1=1.2,b=0.75; ID tie-break
variants: filtered: original top12, exact metadata filters, original order, top3
jevRanked: same eligible candidates reranked by Noul, top3 without cutoff
jevSelected: same reranking with Noul>=0.65, top3
knownRules: Grade, subject, format, estimated duration and authored prerequisite tags checked in code, not delegated to Jev
semanticJudgment: Does material directly practice or explain the actual lesson assignment goal? One independent Noul per candidate, batched per query
gold: Authored target-topic match AND metadata constraints; fixed before API calls. No teacher review, no measured acceptance or time savings.
split: signed-add and letter topic families are dev; all other topic families and missing-topic queries are test. No tuning on either split.
noMatch: 8 test explanation queries with a 1-minute budget plus 2 missing-topic queries. Report separately: metadata impossibility versus semantic mismatch.
metrics: API p50/p95, input/output tokens and total/mean query cost
failurePolicy: Stop on first HTTP/schema failure, preserve raw outputs, no retries or fallback scores
limitations: Only 40 original demo materials; not 20k production resources
Contexts, tags, durations and gold authored by the same assistant; no independent pedagogical validation
Queries share material content and topic definitions; family split is not an unseen-corpus generalization test
Binary suitability ignores preferences among acceptable materials
Small related query families, no independent-sample significance claim
No teacher search-time savings or student learning outcomes measured
